label: Patient portal – new diagnosis added
subject: New Health Record Added to Your Patient Portal
body:
Dear Jane,

A new record has been added to your health profile in the UCSF MyChart Patient Portal.

Record Date: March 7, 2026
Condition: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
Adding Provider: Dr. Sarah Kim, MD — Primary Care

Details: You were diagnosed with Hypertension during your routine wellness visit on March 7, 2026. Your blood pressure reading at the time of diagnosis was 145/92 mmHg, which is above the normal range (under 120/80 mmHg). Dr. Kim has recommended the following course of action:

1. Lifestyle modifications: reduce sodium intake to under 2,300 mg/day, engage in regular aerobic exercise at least 30 minutes five times per week, and increase daily water intake.
2. Medication: Lisinopril 10mg, prescribed once daily in the morning to help manage blood pressure.
3. Follow-up: A follow-up appointment is scheduled for June 2026 to reassess your blood pressure and adjust treatment as needed.

This record is now visible in the "My Health History" section of your patient portal. If you believe this record was added in error, please contact your care team directly.

MyChart Health Portal
UCSF Medical Center
